name: yolk
description: Yolk — Employee Agent. Builds a sanitized daily summary of your workday from local evidence (Claude Code sessions, Screen Time, browser history, git) and sends it to your manager's AI, answers its follow-up questions, and shows you the report and coach brief your manager gets. Only sanitized, business-level text ever leaves your Mac — never raw code, chats, shell commands, URLs, or personal detail (personal time only as a total). Contains no manager logic.
